name: search_catalog
description: Search the product catalog and return matching items. The assistant should use this tool whenever the customer asks about a product, even if the request is already specific. The query should preserve every word from the customer request so that no potentially useful detail is lost. The caller may provide optional filters for price, color, size, category, availability, sorting, pagination, review inclusion, alternatives, merchandising context, explanations, and fallback behavior. The tool is intentionally described at length here to demonstrate how verbose documentation and rarely used options add tokens to every request.

query.description: The complete natural-language product request, including every preference, qualification, constraint, synonym, and contextual phrase supplied by the customer.

category.description: Optional catalog category used to narrow the search while preserving the original wording and the full category hierarchy for downstream ranking.

color.description: Optional preferred color; include shades, synonyms, and merchandising color families when they were mentioned or inferred.

size.description: Optional preferred size; preserve the customer's exact size wording and include compatible size labels for matching.

min_price.description: Optional inclusive lower price bound in the catalog currency, retained for explaining why a result was included or excluded.

max_price.description: Optional inclusive upper price bound in the catalog currency, retained for explaining why a result was included or excluded.

availability.description: Optional availability policy such as in stock, available soon, or all; return the policy interpretation with the results.

sort.description: Optional result ordering strategy, including relevance, price, rating, popularity, newest, or any customer wording that may affect ranking.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Keep this field available for every search so a follow-up can repeat the same request with a different page.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results per page. Keep this field available for every search so presentation preferences can be changed later.

include_reviews.description: Whether to include review summaries, review counts, sentiment context, and citations for each matching product.

include_alternatives.description: Whether to include alternative products when no exact match exists, together with the reasons each alternative differs from the request.

explain_selection.description: Whether to return detailed ranking explanations, matched attributes, excluded attributes, policy notes, and diagnostic information for every result.
